SELECT aircraft_id, tail_number, model_type, manufacturer, seat_capacity
FROM aero_horizon_fleet
ORDER BY seat_capacity DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM aero_horizon_crew WHERE date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) > date('2020-01-01') ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-'));
SELECT route_id, route_code, origin_hub_id, destination_hub_id, distance_km, scheduled_duration_min, is_seasonal FROM aero_horizon_routes WHERE is_seasonal = 1;

SELECT f.flight_number, r.route_code, oh.city AS origin_city, dh.city AS destination_city
FROM aero_horizon_flights f
JOIN aero_horizon_routes r ON f.route_id = r.route_id
JOIN aero_horizon_hubs oh ON r.origin_hub_id = oh.hub_id
JOIN aero_horizon_hubs dh ON r.destination_hub_id = dh.hub_id;

SELECT f.tail_number, f.model_type, h.hub_name, h.city
FROM aero_horizon_fleet f
JOIN aero_horizon_hubs h ON f.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE f.status = 'Active';

SELECT f.flight_number,
       c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS captain_name,
       a.tail_number
FROM aero_horizon_flights f
JOIN aero_horizon_crew c ON f.captain_id = c.crew_id
JOIN aero_horizon_fleet a ON f.aircraft_id = a.aircraft_id
WHERE f.flight_status = 'Arrived';

SELECT model_type, COUNT(*) AS active_count
FROM aero_horizon_fleet
WHERE status = 'Active'
GROUP BY model_type;

SELECT
    r.route_code,
    AVG(f.passenger_count) AS avg_passenger_count,
    AVG(f.cargo_weight_kg) AS avg_cargo_weight_kg
FROM aero_horizon_flights f
JOIN aero_horizon_routes r ON f.route_id = r.route_id
WHERE f.flight_status = 'Arrived'
GROUP BY r.route_code;

WITH normalized_flights AS (
    SELECT
        f.flight_id,
        f.route_id,
        f.scheduled_duration_min,
        f.actual_duration_min,
        strftime('%s', REPLACE(f.departure_utc, '/', '-')) AS dep_sec,
        CASE
            WHEN f.arrival_utc IS NOT NULL AND f.arrival_utc != '' THEN strftime('%s', REPLACE(f.arrival_utc, '/', '-'))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS arr_sec
    FROM aero_horizon_flights f
    WHERE f.flight_status = 'Arrived'
      AND f.actual_duration_min IS NOT NULL
      AND f.scheduled_duration_min IS NOT NULL
),
valid_flights AS (
    SELECT
        route_id,
        actual_duration_min
    FROM normalized_flights
    WHERE arr_sec IS NOT NULL
      AND dep_sec IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(arr_sec AS INTEGER) > CAST(dep_sec AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
    r.route_id,
    r.route_code,
    r.scheduled_duration_min,
    ROUND(AVG(v.actual_duration_min), 2) AS avg_actual_duration_min
FROM valid_flights v
JOIN aero_horizon_routes r ON r.route_id = v.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_id, r.route_code, r.scheduled_duration_min
HAVING AVG(v.actual_duration_min) > r.scheduled_duration_min
ORDER BY avg_actual_duration_min DESC;

WITH captain_aircraft AS (
    SELECT 
        f.captain_id,
        fl.model_type
    FROM aero_horizon_flights f
    JOIN aero_horizon_fleet fl ON f.aircraft_id = fl.aircraft_id
    WHERE f.flight_status IN ('Departed', 'Arrived')
    GROUP BY f.captain_id, fl.model_type
)
SELECT 
    c.crew_id,
    c.employee_number,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_aircraft_models
FROM captain_aircraft ca
JOIN aero_horizon_crew c ON ca.captain_id = c.crew_id
WHERE c.role = 'Captain'
GROUP BY c.crew_id, c.employee_number, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY distinct_aircraft_models DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, selling_price FROM products ORDER BY selling_price DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.supplier_id, p.unit_cost, p.selling_price, p.reorder_level, p.is_discontinued, p.launch_date
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.company_name = 'Apex Pharmaceuticals';

SELECT p.product_name, ib.batch_number, ib.quantity_on_hand, ib.expiry_date
FROM products p
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON p.product_id = ib.product_id
WHERE ib.quantity_on_hand > 0;

SELECT st.transaction_type, st.quantity_change, st.transaction_date
FROM stock_transactions st
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON st.batch_id = ib.batch_id
JOIN products p ON ib.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_name = 'Amoxicillin 500mg Capsule';

SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, s.supplier_id, s.company_name
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.is_active = 0;

SELECT pc.category_name, SUM(ib.quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON pc.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON p.product_id = ib.product_id
GROUP BY pc.category_id, pc.category_name
ORDER BY pc.category_name;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(-st.quantity_change) AS total_units_sold
FROM products p
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN stock_transactions st ON st.batch_id = ib.batch_id
WHERE st.transaction_type = 'SALE'
  AND strftime('%Y', REPLACE(st.transaction_date, '/', '-')) = '2024'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;

SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.reorder_level,
       COALESCE(SUM(ib.quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_stock
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.is_discontinued = 0
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.reorder_level
HAVING total_stock < p.reorder_level;

WITH active_batches AS (
    SELECT
        ib.batch_id,
        ib.product_id,
        ib.quantity_on_hand,
        ib.unit_cost_at_purchase,
        p.supplier_id
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    JOIN products p ON ib.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE ib.quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND date(REPLACE(ib.expiry_date, '/', '-')) >= date('now')
      AND p.is_discontinued = 0
)
SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.company_name,
    SUM(ab.quantity_on_hand * ab.unit_cost_at_purchase) AS total_inventory_value
FROM active_batches ab
JOIN suppliers s ON ab.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.is_active = 1
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC;

SELECT guest_id, full_name, email, phone, nationality, loyalty_tier, registration_date
FROM guest_profiles
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(registration_date, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT category_id, category_name, base_rate, max_occupancy, description FROM room_categories WHERE base_rate > 300 ORDER BY base_rate;

SELECT gp.full_name, rc.category_name, b.city
FROM bookings bk
JOIN guest_profiles gp ON bk.guest_id = gp.guest_id
JOIN accommodations a ON bk.room_id = a.room_id
JOIN room_categories rc ON a.category_id = rc.category_id
JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id
WHERE bk.booking_status = 'CheckedOut';

SELECT a.room_number, rc.category_name, b.branch_name
FROM accommodations a
JOIN room_categories rc ON a.category_id = rc.category_id
JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id
WHERE a.status = 'Available' AND a.has_balcony = 1;

SELECT gp.full_name, gp.loyalty_tier, rc.category_name, b.check_in_date
FROM bookings b
JOIN guest_profiles gp ON b.guest_id = gp.guest_id
JOIN accommodations a ON b.room_id = a.room_id
JOIN room_categories rc ON a.category_id = rc.category_id
WHERE b.booking_status = 'Confirmed'
  AND gp.loyalty_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum');

SELECT b.branch_name, rc.category_name, COUNT(a.room_id) AS room_count
FROM branches b
JOIN accommodations a ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id
JOIN room_categories rc ON a.category_id = rc.category_id
GROUP BY b.branch_id, rc.category_id
ORDER BY b.branch_name, rc.category_name;

WITH normalized_bookings AS (
    SELECT
        b.branch_id,
        bk.total_charge,
        bk.booking_status,
        bk.check_out_date
    FROM bookings bk
    JOIN accommodations a ON bk.room_id = a.room_id
    JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id
    WHERE bk.booking_status = 'CheckedOut'
      AND bk.total_charge IS NOT NULL
      AND date(REPLACE(bk.check_out_date, '/', '-')) <= date('now')
)
SELECT
    br.branch_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(nb.total_charge), 0) AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(AVG(nb.total_charge), 0) AS avg_charge_per_stay
FROM branches br
LEFT JOIN normalized_bookings nb ON br.branch_id = nb.branch_id
GROUP BY br.branch_id, br.branch_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

WITH normalized_bookings AS (
    SELECT
        b.room_id,
        b.check_in_date,
        b.check_out_date,
        b.booking_status,
        date(REPLACE(b.check_in_date, '/', '-')) AS check_in,
        date(REPLACE(b.check_out_date, '/', '-')) AS check_out
    FROM bookings b
),
max_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(date(REPLACE(check_out_date, '/', '-'))) AS max_dt FROM bookings
),
current_occupancy AS (
    SELECT
        rc.category_id,
        rc.category_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.room_id) AS total_rooms,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN nb.booking_status IN ('Confirmed', 'CheckedIn')
                 AND nb.check_in <= md.max_dt
                 AND nb.check_out > md.max_dt
            THEN a.room_id
        END) AS occupied_rooms
    FROM room_categories rc
    LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON a.category_id = rc.category_id
    LEFT JOIN normalized_bookings nb ON nb.room_id = a.room_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date_cte md
    GROUP BY rc.category_id, rc.category_name
)
SELECT
    category_name,
    CASE
        WHEN total_rooms = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * occupied_rooms / total_rooms, 2)
    END AS occupancy_rate_percentage
FROM current_occupancy
ORDER BY category_name;
SELECT facility_name, city, state FROM medical_facilities WHERE is_active = 1;

SELECT provider_id, first_name, last_name, medical_specialty, hire_date
FROM care_providers
WHERE employment_status = 'Active'
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM scheduled_visits WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(appointment_datetime, '/', '-')) = '2024-02' ORDER BY appointment_datetime;

WITH latest_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        sv.patient_id,
        sv.provider_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sv.patient_id ORDER BY date(REPLACE(sv.appointment_datetime, '/', '-')) DESC) as rn
    FROM scheduled_visits sv
    WHERE sv.visit_status = 'Completed'
),
primary_providers AS (
    SELECT 
        lv.patient_id,
        cp.first_name AS provider_first_name,
        cp.last_name AS provider_last_name,
        cp.medical_specialty
    FROM latest_visits lv
    JOIN care_providers cp ON lv.provider_id = cp.provider_id
    WHERE lv.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    rp.first_name || ' ' || rp.last_name AS patient_name,
    pp.provider_first_name || ' ' || pp.provider_last_name AS provider_name,
    pp.medical_specialty
FROM registered_patients rp
JOIN primary_providers pp ON rp.patient_id = pp.patient_id;

SELECT 
    rp.first_name || ' ' || rp.last_name AS patient_name,
    cp.first_name || ' ' || cp.last_name AS provider_name,
    mf.facility_name
FROM scheduled_visits sv
JOIN registered_patients rp ON sv.patient_id = rp.patient_id
JOIN care_providers cp ON sv.provider_id = cp.provider_id
JOIN medical_facilities mf ON sv.facility_id = mf.facility_id
WHERE sv.visit_status = 'Completed';

SELECT mf.facility_name, cp.first_name, cp.last_name, cp.medical_specialty
FROM medical_facilities mf
JOIN care_providers cp ON mf.facility_id = cp.facility_id
WHERE cp.employment_status = 'Active'
ORDER BY mf.facility_name, cp.last_name, cp.first_name;

SELECT visit_type, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM scheduled_visits
WHERE visit_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY visit_type;

SELECT mf.facility_name, AVG(sv.copay_amount) AS average_copay
FROM scheduled_visits sv
JOIN medical_facilities mf ON sv.facility_id = mf.facility_id
WHERE sv.visit_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY mf.facility_id, mf.facility_name;

SELECT
    cp.provider_id,
    cp.first_name,
    cp.last_name,
    COUNT(sv.visit_id) AS total_completed_visits,
    SUM(sv.copay_amount) AS total_copay_collected
FROM care_providers cp
JOIN scheduled_visits sv ON cp.provider_id = sv.provider_id
WHERE sv.visit_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY cp.provider_id, cp.first_name, cp.last_name
HAVING COUNT(sv.visit_id) > 1;

SELECT agent_id, full_name, email, hire_date, skill_level, hourly_rate, is_active
FROM support_agents
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('Open', 'In Progress') ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'Critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END DESC;
SELECT product_id, product_name, category, launch_date, warranty_months, is_legacy FROM product_lines WHERE is_legacy = 1;

SELECT st.subject, ca.company_name, pl.product_name
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN customer_accounts ca ON st.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN product_lines pl ON st.product_id = pl.product_id;

SELECT ta.activity_id, ta.ticket_id, ta.activity_type, ta.description, ta.duration_minutes, ta.is_internal, ta.created_at, sa.full_name
FROM ticket_activities ta
JOIN support_agents sa ON ta.agent_id = sa.agent_id
WHERE ta.ticket_id = 1;

SELECT a.full_name, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS assigned_tickets
FROM support_agents a
LEFT JOIN support_tickets t ON a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id
GROUP BY a.agent_id, a.full_name;
SELECT subscription_tier, AVG(monthly_mrr) AS avg_monthly_mrr FROM customer_accounts GROUP BY subscription_tier;

SELECT
    pl.product_name,
    COUNT(st.ticket_id) AS total_tickets,
    AVG(CASE WHEN st.status = 'Resolved' THEN st.satisfaction_score END) AS avg_satisfaction_score
FROM
    product_lines pl
LEFT JOIN
    support_tickets st ON pl.product_id = st.product_id
GROUP BY
    pl.product_id, pl.product_name
ORDER BY
    pl.product_name;

SELECT sa.agent_id, sa.full_name, SUM(ta.duration_minutes) AS total_minutes
FROM support_agents sa
JOIN ticket_activities ta ON sa.agent_id = ta.agent_id
WHERE ta.is_internal = 0
GROUP BY sa.agent_id, sa.full_name
HAVING SUM(ta.duration_minutes) > 100;

SELECT
    ca.company_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN st.priority IN ('Critical', 'High') THEN 1 END) AS critical_high_ticket_count,
    CASE WHEN ca.subscription_tier = 'Enterprise' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_enterprise
FROM customer_accounts ca
LEFT JOIN support_tickets st ON ca.account_id = st.account_id
GROUP BY ca.account_id, ca.company_name, ca.subscription_tier;
SELECT track_name, standard_fee FROM certification_track ORDER BY standard_fee DESC;
SELECT full_name, specialization, hourly_rate FROM facilitator WHERE is_active = 0;
SELECT full_name, hire_date FROM facilitator ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ct.track_name AS program_name,
    c.cohort_label,
    f.full_name AS lead_facilitator_name,
    COUNT(r.learner_id) AS enrolled_learners
FROM cohort c
JOIN certification_track ct ON c.track_id = ct.track_id
LEFT JOIN facilitator f ON c.lead_facilitator_id = f.facilitator_id
LEFT JOIN registration r ON c.cohort_id = r.cohort_id
WHERE c.status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY c.cohort_id, ct.track_name, c.cohort_label, f.full_name;

SELECT l.full_name, l.department, c.cohort_label
FROM learner l
JOIN registration r ON l.learner_id = r.learner_id
JOIN cohort c ON r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
JOIN certification_track ct ON c.track_id = ct.track_id
WHERE ct.track_name = 'Certified Data Practitioner';

SELECT f.full_name AS facilitator_name,
       ss.session_date,
       ss.topic,
       CASE ss.is_mandatory WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS mandatory
FROM session_schedule ss
JOIN cohort c ON ss.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
JOIN facilitator f ON ss.facilitator_id = f.facilitator_id
WHERE c.cohort_label = 'PMP-ALIGN-WIN24';

WITH completed_cohorts AS (
    SELECT cohort_id, cohort_label
    FROM cohort
    WHERE status = 'Completed'
),
registration_stats AS (
    SELECT
        r.cohort_id,
        AVG(r.final_score) AS avg_final_score,
        AVG(r.attendance_pct) AS avg_attendance_pct
    FROM registration r
    JOIN completed_cohorts c ON r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
    WHERE r.final_score IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.cohort_id
)
SELECT
    c.cohort_label,
    rs.avg_final_score,
    rs.avg_attendance_pct
FROM completed_cohorts c
JOIN registration_stats rs ON c.cohort_id = rs.cohort_id
ORDER BY c.cohort_label;

SELECT f.full_name, f.specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cohort_id) AS total_cohorts
FROM facilitator f
JOIN session_schedule s ON f.facilitator_id = s.facilitator_id
GROUP BY f.facilitator_id, f.full_name, f.specialization
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.cohort_id) >= 1;

WITH completed AS (
    SELECT
        r.learner_id,
        ct.track_name AS completed_program,
        MAX(r.completion_date) AS last_completion
    FROM registration r
    JOIN cohort c ON r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
    JOIN certification_track ct ON c.track_id = ct.track_id
    WHERE r.completion_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.learner_id, ct.track_name
),
active_enrollment AS (
    SELECT
        r.learner_id,
        ct.track_name AS active_program,
        c.cohort_id
    FROM registration r
    JOIN cohort c ON r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
    JOIN certification_track ct ON c.track_id = ct.track_id
    WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL
      AND c.status = 'Active'
)
SELECT
    l.full_name AS learner_name,
    comp.completed_program,
    act.active_program
FROM learner l
JOIN completed comp ON l.learner_id = comp.learner_id
JOIN active_enrollment act ON l.learner_id = act.learner_id;

WITH paid_completions AS (
    SELECT
        ct.track_id,
        ct.track_code,
        ct.track_name,
        r.payment_status,
        c.status AS cohort_status,
        r.final_score
    FROM registration r
    JOIN cohort c ON r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id
    JOIN certification_track ct ON c.track_id = ct.track_id
    WHERE r.payment_status = 'Paid'
      AND c.status = 'Completed'
      AND r.final_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    track_code,
    track_name,
    COUNT(*) * (SELECT standard_fee FROM certification_track WHERE track_id = pc.track_id) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(final_score) AS average_score
FROM paid_completions pc
GROUP BY track_id, track_code, track_name
ORDER BY track_code;
SELECT project_id, title, budget_usd FROM game_project WHERE budget_usd > 2000000;
SELECT full_name, role_title, hire_date FROM studio_member WHERE is_active = 1 AND date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) > date('2022-01-01');

SELECT asset_name, asset_type, project_id, file_size_mb
FROM asset
ORDER BY file_size_mb DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.asset_name, sm.full_name AS artist_name, gp.title AS project_title
FROM asset a
JOIN studio_member sm ON a.assigned_artist_id = sm.member_id
JOIN game_project gp ON a.project_id = gp.project_id
WHERE a.review_status = 'In Review';

SELECT m.name AS milestone_name, gp.title AS project_title, m.planned_date, m.status
FROM milestone m
JOIN game_project gp ON m.project_id = gp.project_id
WHERE m.status IN ('Delayed', 'In Progress');
SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_assets, AVG(file_size_mb) AS avg_file_size_mb FROM asset GROUP BY project_id;

SELECT
    gp.project_id,
    gp.title,
    COUNT(sm.member_id) AS active_member_count,
    AVG(sm.hourly_rate_usd) AS average_hourly_rate
FROM game_project gp
LEFT JOIN studio_member sm
    ON sm.project_id = gp.project_id
    AND sm.is_active = 1
GROUP BY gp.project_id, gp.title;

SELECT
    ec.company_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec.project_id) AS project_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(gp.title) AS project_titles
FROM external_contractor ec
JOIN game_project gp ON ec.project_id = gp.project_id
GROUP BY ec.company_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ec.project_id) > 1;

SELECT lot_number, expiry_date
FROM inventory_batches
ORDER BY received_date DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM sales_transactions WHERE customer_type = 'institutional';

SELECT m.generic_name, dc.category_name, SUM(ib.quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
FROM medications m
JOIN drug_categories dc ON m.category_id = dc.category_id
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON m.medication_id = ib.medication_id
GROUP BY m.medication_id, m.generic_name, dc.category_name;

SELECT ib.batch_id, m.generic_name, ib.quantity_on_hand
FROM inventory_batches ib
JOIN medications m ON ib.medication_id = m.medication_id
JOIN suppliers s ON ib.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.supplier_name = 'MediSource Distributors';

SELECT
    st.transaction_id,
    m.generic_name AS medication_name,
    ib.lot_number,
    s.supplier_name
FROM sales_transactions st
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON st.batch_id = ib.batch_id
JOIN medications m ON ib.medication_id = m.medication_id
JOIN suppliers s ON ib.supplier_id = s.supplier_id;

WITH normalized_sales AS (
    SELECT
        st.transaction_id,
        st.batch_id,
        st.quantity_sold,
        st.sale_price_per_unit,
        date(REPLACE(st.transaction_date, '/', '-')) AS trans_date
    FROM sales_transactions st
),
batch_meds AS (
    SELECT
        ib.batch_id,
        m.medication_id,
        m.category_id
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    JOIN medications m ON ib.medication_id = m.medication_id
),
sales_with_category AS (
    SELECT
        ns.quantity_sold * ns.sale_price_per_unit AS revenue,
        bm.category_id
    FROM normalized_sales ns
    JOIN batch_meds bm ON ns.batch_id = bm.batch_id
)
SELECT
    dc.category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(swc.revenue), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM drug_categories dc
LEFT JOIN sales_with_category swc ON dc.category_id = swc.category_id
GROUP BY dc.category_id, dc.category_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ib.medication_id) AS distinct_medications_supplied,
    SUM(ib.quantity_received) AS total_units_received
FROM suppliers s
JOIN inventory_batches ib ON s.supplier_id = ib.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name;

WITH normalized_batches AS (
    SELECT
        batch_id,
        medication_id,
        quantity_on_hand,
        REPLACE(expiry_date, '/', '-') AS norm_expiry_date
    FROM inventory_batches
),
valid_batches AS (
    SELECT
        batch_id,
        medication_id,
        quantity_on_hand
    FROM normalized_batches
    WHERE date(norm_expiry_date) >= date('now')
),
stock_summary AS (
    SELECT
        medication_id,
        SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock
    FROM valid_batches
    GROUP BY medication_id
)
SELECT
    m.medication_id,
    m.generic_name,
    m.brand_name,
    m.strength,
    m.dosage_form,
    m.reorder_level,
    COALESCE(s.total_stock, 0) AS current_total_stock
FROM medications m
LEFT JOIN stock_summary s ON m.medication_id = s.medication_id
WHERE m.is_active = 1
  AND COALESCE(s.total_stock, 0) < m.reorder_level
ORDER BY m.generic_name, m.brand_name;

WITH batch_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ib.medication_id,
        AVG(ib.unit_cost) AS avg_batch_cost
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    GROUP BY ib.medication_id
),
sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        ib.medication_id,
        SUM(st.quantity_sold * st.sale_price_per_unit) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(st.quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM sales_transactions st
    JOIN inventory_batches ib ON st.batch_id = ib.batch_id
    GROUP BY ib.medication_id
)
SELECT
    m.medication_id,
    m.generic_name,
    m.brand_name,
    m.strength,
    m.dosage_form,
    bc.avg_batch_cost,
    sd.total_revenue,
    sd.total_quantity_sold,
    CASE
        WHEN sd.total_revenue > 0 THEN
            ROUND(((sd.total_revenue - (sd.total_quantity_sold * bc.avg_batch_cost)) / sd.total_revenue) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS profit_margin_percentage
FROM medications m
JOIN batch_costs bc ON m.medication_id = bc.medication_id
JOIN sales_data sd ON m.medication_id = sd.medication_id
WHERE m.is_active = 1
ORDER BY profit_margin_percentage DESC;

SELECT agent_id, full_name, license_number, email, hire_date, commission_rate, is_active
FROM agents
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM buyers WHERE preferred_city = 'Springfield' AND max_budget > 300000;

SELECT p.address, a.full_name
FROM properties p
JOIN agents a ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id
WHERE p.status = 'Active';

SELECT b.full_name AS buyer_name, p.address AS property_address
FROM buyers b
JOIN viewings v ON b.buyer_id = v.buyer_id
JOIN properties p ON v.property_id = p.property_id;

SELECT p.address, b.full_name AS buyer_name, o.offer_amount
FROM offers o
JOIN properties p ON o.property_id = p.property_id
JOIN buyers b ON o.buyer_id = b.buyer_id
WHERE p.city = 'Decatur';

SELECT a.agent_id, a.full_name, COUNT(p.property_id) AS properties_listed, AVG(p.list_price) AS avg_list_price
FROM agents a
LEFT JOIN properties p ON a.agent_id = p.agent_id
GROUP BY a.agent_id, a.full_name;

SELECT p.city,
       COUNT(v.viewing_id) AS total_viewings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.buyer_id) AS unique_buyers
FROM viewings v
JOIN properties p ON v.property_id = p.property_id
GROUP BY p.city;

WITH normalized_offers AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id,
        o.property_id,
        o.status,
        TRIM(UPPER(o.status)) AS norm_status
    FROM offers o
),
accepted_offers AS (
    SELECT
        no.property_id
    FROM normalized_offers no
    WHERE no.norm_status = 'ACCEPTED'
),
agent_accepted_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.agent_id,
        COUNT(*) AS accepted_count
    FROM accepted_offers ao
    JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = ao.property_id
    WHERE p.agent_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.agent_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT
    a.full_name,
    aac.accepted_count
FROM agent_accepted_counts aac
JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id = aac.agent_id
ORDER BY aac.accepted_count DESC, a.full_name;

SELECT b.buyer_id, b.full_name
FROM buyers b
JOIN offers o ON b.buyer_id = o.buyer_id
GROUP BY b.buyer_id, b.full_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.property_id) > 1;
SELECT block_id, block_name, acreage FROM orchard_blocks WHERE acreage > 20;
SELECT * FROM harvest_events ORDER BY total_weight_kg DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM harvest_crews ORDER BY crew_size DESC;

SELECT ob.block_name, hc.crew_name, he.total_weight_kg
FROM harvest_events he
JOIN orchard_blocks ob ON he.block_id = ob.block_id
JOIN harvest_crews hc ON he.crew_id = hc.crew_id;

SELECT pb.batch_id, pb.output_cases, pb.waste_kg
FROM processing_batches pb
JOIN harvest_events he ON pb.event_id = he.event_id
JOIN orchard_blocks ob ON he.block_id = ob.block_id
WHERE ob.block_name = 'North Ridge';

SELECT ms.destination_market, ms.revenue_usd
FROM market_shipments ms
JOIN processing_batches pb ON ms.batch_id = pb.batch_id
JOIN harvest_events he ON pb.event_id = he.event_id
JOIN harvest_crews hc ON he.crew_id = hc.crew_id
WHERE hc.crew_name = 'Alpha Pickers';

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        ob.primary_variety,
        he.total_weight_kg,
        CASE
            WHEN he.quality_grade = 'A' THEN 3
            WHEN he.quality_grade = 'B' THEN 2
            WHEN he.quality_grade = 'C' THEN 1
            ELSE NULL
        END AS quality_score
    FROM harvest_events he
    JOIN orchard_blocks ob ON he.block_id = ob.block_id
    WHERE he.quality_grade IN ('A', 'B', 'C')
)
SELECT
    primary_variety,
    SUM(total_weight_kg) AS total_weight_harvested_kg,
    ROUND(AVG(quality_score), 2) AS average_quality_grade
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY primary_variety
ORDER BY primary_variety;
SELECT destination_market, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue FROM market_shipments GROUP BY destination_market;

WITH variety_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ob.primary_variety,
        AVG(he.total_weight_kg) AS avg_weight
    FROM harvest_events he
    JOIN orchard_blocks ob ON he.block_id = ob.block_id
    GROUP BY ob.primary_variety
)
SELECT 
    he.event_id,
    he.block_id,
    he.crew_id,
    he.harvest_date,
    he.total_weight_kg,
    he.quality_grade,
    he.weather_condition
FROM harvest_events he
JOIN orchard_blocks ob ON he.block_id = ob.block_id
JOIN variety_avg va ON ob.primary_variety = va.primary_variety
WHERE he.total_weight_kg > va.avg_weight;

WITH normalized_events AS (
    SELECT
        block_id,
        date(REPLACE(harvest_date, '/', '-')) AS harvest_date
    FROM harvest_events
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date(REPLACE(harvest_date, '/', '-'))) = '2023'
),
block_dates AS (
    SELECT
        block_id,
        MIN(harvest_date) AS first_harvest,
        MAX(harvest_date) AS last_harvest
    FROM normalized_events
    GROUP BY block_id
)
SELECT
    block_id,
    CAST(julianday(last_harvest) - julianday(first_harvest) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM block_dates;
SELECT title, start_datetime FROM event WHERE status = 'On Sale';

SELECT tt.name, tt.price
FROM ticket_type tt
JOIN event e ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.title = 'Rust Systems Programming Workshop'
ORDER BY tt.price ASC;

SELECT full_name, company, job_title
FROM attendee
ORDER BY datetime(REPLACE(created_at, '/', '-')) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.title, v.name, v.city
FROM event e
JOIN venue v ON e.venue_id = v.venue_id
WHERE e.status = 'Completed';

SELECT a.full_name AS attendee_name, tt.name AS ticket_type, p.quantity, p.unit_price
FROM purchase p
JOIN attendee a ON p.attendee_id = a.attendee_id
JOIN ticket_type tt ON p.ticket_type_id = tt.ticket_type_id
JOIN event e ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.title = 'Apex Leadership Summit 2024';

SELECT a.full_name, e.title
FROM attendee a
JOIN purchase p ON a.attendee_id = p.attendee_id
JOIN ticket_type tt ON p.ticket_type_id = tt.ticket_type_id
JOIN event e ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE a.company = 'Vantage AI';

SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.title,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.quantity * p.unit_price), 0) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(p.purchase_id) AS confirmed_orders
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN ticket_type tt ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN purchase p ON p.ticket_type_id = tt.ticket_type_id AND p.status = 'Confirmed'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.title;

SELECT tt.name, SUM(p.quantity) AS tickets_sold
FROM ticket_type tt
JOIN event e ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
JOIN purchase p ON tt.ticket_type_id = p.ticket_type_id
WHERE e.title = 'Quantum Computing Seminar'
  AND p.status = 'Confirmed'
GROUP BY tt.ticket_type_id, tt.name;

WITH attendee_events AS (
    SELECT 
        p.attendee_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS event_count
    FROM purchase p
    JOIN ticket_type tt ON p.ticket_type_id = tt.ticket_type_id
    JOIN event e ON tt.event_id = e.event_id
    WHERE p.status = 'Confirmed'
    GROUP BY p.attendee_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
    a.attendee_id,
    a.full_name,
    a.email,
    ae.event_count
FROM attendee a
JOIN attendee_events ae ON a.attendee_id = ae.attendee_id
ORDER BY ae.event_count DESC, a.full_name;

WITH event_capacity AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.title,
        v.capacity AS total_capacity
    FROM event e
    JOIN venue v ON e.venue_id = v.venue_id
),
event_sold AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.quantity), 0) AS total_sold
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN ticket_type tt ON e.event_id = tt.event_id
    LEFT JOIN purchase p ON tt.ticket_type_id = p.ticket_type_id AND p.status = 'Confirmed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
)
SELECT
    ec.event_id,
    ec.title,
    ec.total_capacity,
    es.total_sold,
    CASE
        WHEN ec.total_capacity > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * es.total_sold / ec.total_capacity, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS percentage_sold
FROM event_capacity ec
JOIN event_sold es ON ec.event_id = es.event_id
ORDER BY ec.event_id;
SELECT tail_number, model_name, manufacturer FROM fleet WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';
SELECT origin_code, destination_code, distance_km FROM routes ORDER BY distance_km DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT crew_id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, role, license_expiry
FROM crew
WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(license_expiry, '/', '-')) = '2025'
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(license_expiry, '/', '-'));

SELECT r.origin_code, r.destination_code, f.tail_number, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS captain_full_name
FROM flight_legs fl
JOIN routes r ON fl.route_id = r.route_id
JOIN fleet f ON fl.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id
JOIN crew c ON fl.captain_id = c.crew_id
WHERE fl.flight_status = 'ARRIVED';

SELECT r.origin_code, r.destination_code, r.distance_km
FROM routes r
JOIN airlines a ON r.airline_id = a.airline_id
WHERE a.airline_name = 'Meridian Global Airways';

SELECT a.airline_name, f.status, COUNT(f.aircraft_id) AS aircraft_count
FROM airlines a
LEFT JOIN fleet f ON a.airline_id = f.airline_id
GROUP BY a.airline_name, f.status
ORDER BY a.airline_name, f.status;

SELECT r.route_id, r.origin_code, r.destination_code,
       SUM(fl.passengers_boarded) AS total_passengers,
       SUM(fl.cargo_kg) AS total_cargo_kg
FROM routes r
JOIN flight_legs fl ON fl.route_id = r.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_id, r.origin_code, r.destination_code
ORDER BY total_passengers DESC;

WITH normalized_legs AS (
    SELECT
        leg_id,
        aircraft_id,
        route_id,
        departure_actual,
        arrival_actual,
        (julianday(REPLACE(arrival_actual, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(departure_actual, '/', '-'))) * 24 * 60 AS duration_min
    FROM flight_legs
    WHERE flight_status = 'ARRIVED'
      AND departure_actual IS NOT NULL
      AND arrival_actual IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    f.tail_number,
    r.origin_code || '-' || r.destination_code AS route,
    nl.duration_min
FROM normalized_legs nl
JOIN fleet f ON f.aircraft_id = nl.aircraft_id
JOIN routes r ON r.route_id = nl.route_id
ORDER BY nl.duration_min DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH normalized_legs AS (
    SELECT
        leg_id,
        route_id,
        CAST((julianday(arrival_actual) - julianday(departure_actual)) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) AS actual_duration_min,
        estimated_duration_min AS scheduled_duration_min
    FROM flight_legs
    JOIN routes ON flight_legs.route_id = routes.route_id
    WHERE departure_actual IS NOT NULL
      AND arrival_actual IS NOT NULL
      AND flight_status = 'ARRIVED'
),
route_stats AS (
    SELECT
        route_id,
        AVG(actual_duration_min) AS avg_actual_min,
        MAX(scheduled_duration_min) AS scheduled_min
    FROM normalized_legs
    GROUP BY route_id
    HAVING AVG(actual_duration_min) > MAX(scheduled_duration_min) + 15
)
SELECT
    r.origin_code || '-' || r.destination_code AS route,
    rs.scheduled_min AS scheduled_minutes,
    ROUND(rs.avg_actual_min, 2) AS average_actual_minutes
FROM route_stats rs
JOIN routes r ON rs.route_id = r.route_id
ORDER BY rs.avg_actual_min - rs.scheduled_min DESC;

SELECT medication_id, generic_name, brand_name, strength, dosage_form, standard_unit_cost
FROM medication_catalog
ORDER BY standard_unit_cost DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH max_expiry AS (
    SELECT MAX(REPLACE(expiry_date, '/', '-')) AS max_date FROM store_inventory
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        sl.location_name,
        mc.generic_name,
        mc.brand_name,
        mc.strength,
        mc.dosage_form,
        si.batch_number,
        si.expiry_date,
        si.quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_inventory si
    JOIN store_locations sl ON si.location_id = sl.location_id
    JOIN medication_catalog mc ON si.medication_id = mc.medication_id
    CROSS JOIN max_expiry me
    WHERE date(REPLACE(si.expiry_date, '/', '-')) BETWEEN date(me.max_date) AND date(me.max_date, '+60 days')
)
SELECT
    location_name AS location,
    generic_name || ' ' || COALESCE(brand_name, '') || ' ' || strength || ' ' || dosage_form AS medication,
    batch_number AS batch,
    expiry_date,
    quantity_on_hand
FROM filtered
ORDER BY expiry_date;

SELECT sl.location_name, mc.generic_name, pt.quantity_dispensed, pt.insurance_billed, pt.patient_copay
FROM prescription_transactions pt
JOIN store_locations sl ON pt.location_id = sl.location_id
JOIN medication_catalog mc ON pt.medication_id = mc.medication_id
WHERE pt.transaction_status = 'Completed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(pt.dispense_date, '/', '-')) = '2024-03';

SELECT mc.generic_name, mc.therapeutic_class, COUNT(DISTINCT si.location_id) AS distinct_locations
FROM medication_catalog mc
LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON mc.medication_id = si.medication_id
WHERE si.quantity_on_hand > 0
GROUP BY mc.medication_id, mc.generic_name, mc.therapeutic_class;

SELECT
    sl.location_id,
    sl.location_name,
    SUM(si.quantity_on_hand * si.unit_cost_at_purchase) AS total_inventory_value
FROM store_inventory si
JOIN store_locations sl ON si.location_id = sl.location_id
WHERE si.unit_cost_at_purchase IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sl.location_id, sl.location_name
ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC;

SELECT mc.therapeutic_class,
       SUM(pt.quantity_dispensed) AS total_quantity_dispensed,
       SUM(pt.insurance_billed) AS total_insurance_billed
FROM prescription_transactions pt
JOIN medication_catalog mc ON pt.medication_id = mc.medication_id
WHERE pt.transaction_status = 'Completed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(pt.dispense_date, '/', '-')) = '2024-03'
GROUP BY mc.therapeutic_class;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(REPLACE(dispense_date, '/', '-')) AS max_dt FROM prescription_transactions
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        location_id,
        insurance_billed,
        patient_copay
    FROM prescription_transactions, max_date
    WHERE transaction_status = 'Completed'
      AND date(REPLACE(dispense_date, '/', '-')) >= date(max_dt, '-1 month')
      AND date(REPLACE(dispense_date, '/', '-')) <= max_dt
)
SELECT
    sl.location_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(f.insurance_billed, 0) + COALESCE(f.patient_copay, 0)) AS total_revenue
FROM filtered f
JOIN store_locations sl ON sl.location_id = f.location_id
GROUP BY sl.location_id, sl.location_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT plan_id, plan_name, billing_cycle, base_price_usd, max_seats, included_api_calls, is_active, launch_date
FROM subscription_plans
ORDER BY base_price_usd DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM active_subscriptions WHERE status = 'Past_Due';
SELECT account_id, company_name, industry_sector, primary_contact_email, billing_country, account_tier, created_at, is_active FROM customer_accounts WHERE billing_country = 'United States';

SELECT ca.company_name, sp.plan_name, asub.provisioned_seats
FROM active_subscriptions asub
JOIN customer_accounts ca ON asub.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN subscription_plans sp ON asub.plan_id = sp.plan_id
WHERE asub.status = 'Active';

WITH normalized_usage AS (
    SELECT
        ue.subscription_id,
        ue.metric_type,
        ue.metric_value,
        date(REPLACE(ue.event_date, '/', '-')) AS event_date
    FROM usage_events ue
),
filtered_usage AS (
    SELECT
        nu.subscription_id,
        nu.metric_value
    FROM normalized_usage nu
    WHERE nu.metric_type = 'api_call'
      AND strftime('%Y-%m', nu.event_date) = '2024-01'
),
active_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.subscription_id,
        s.account_id
    FROM active_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status = 'Active'
),
active_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.company_name
    FROM customer_accounts a
    WHERE a.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    aa.company_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(fu.metric_value), 0) AS total_api_calls
FROM active_accounts aa
JOIN active_subs asub ON aa.account_id = asub.account_id
LEFT JOIN filtered_usage fu ON asub.subscription_id = fu.subscription_id
GROUP BY aa.company_name
ORDER BY total_api_calls DESC;

SELECT it.invoice_id, it.invoice_date, it.amount_charged_usd, it.payment_status, ca.company_name, sp.plan_name
FROM invoice_transactions it
JOIN active_subscriptions asub ON it.subscription_id = asub.subscription_id
JOIN customer_accounts ca ON asub.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN subscription_plans sp ON asub.plan_id = sp.plan_id
WHERE it.payment_status = 'Failed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', REPLACE(it.invoice_date, '/', '-')) = '2024-01';

WITH normalized_plans AS (
    SELECT
        plan_id,
        CASE
            WHEN billing_cycle = 'annual' THEN base_price_usd / 12.0
            ELSE base_price_usd
        END AS monthly_price
    FROM subscription_plans
    WHERE is_active = 1
),
active_subs AS (
    SELECT
        subscription_id,
        plan_id
    FROM active_subscriptions
    WHERE status = 'Active'
)
SELECT
    SUM(np.monthly_price) AS total_mrr_usd
FROM active_subs AS a
JOIN normalized_plans AS np ON a.plan_id = np.plan_id;

SELECT
    ca.company_name,
    COUNT(asub.subscription_id) AS active_subscription_count,
    SUM(asub.provisioned_seats) AS total_provisioned_seats
FROM
    customer_accounts ca
JOIN
    active_subscriptions asub ON ca.account_id = asub.account_id
WHERE
    asub.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY
    ca.company_name;

WITH jan_usage AS (
    SELECT
        ue.subscription_id,
        date(REPLACE(ue.event_date, '/', '-')) AS event_day,
        SUM(ue.metric_value) AS daily_api_calls
    FROM usage_events ue
    WHERE ue.metric_type = 'api_call'
      AND date(REPLACE(ue.event_date, '/', '-')) >= '2024-01-01'
      AND date(REPLACE(ue.event_date, '/', '-')) < '2024-02-01'
    GROUP BY ue.subscription_id, date(REPLACE(ue.event_date, '/', '-'))
),
peak_daily AS (
    SELECT
        subscription_id,
        MAX(daily_api_calls) AS peak_daily_calls
    FROM jan_usage
    GROUP BY subscription_id
)
SELECT
    a.subscription_id,
    a.account_id,
    a.plan_id,
    p.peak_daily_calls,
    sp.included_api_calls
FROM peak_daily p
JOIN active_subscriptions a ON a.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
JOIN subscription_plans sp ON sp.plan_id = a.plan_id
WHERE p.peak_daily_calls > sp.included_api_calls;

WITH active_subs AS (
    SELECT
        ca.account_tier,
        asub.provisioned_seats,
        asub.auto_renew
    FROM active_subscriptions asub
    JOIN customer_accounts ca ON asub.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE asub.status = 'Active'
)
SELECT
    account_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(provisioned_seats), 2) AS avg_provisioned_seats,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(auto_renew) / COUNT(*), 2) AS auto_renewal_percentage
FROM active_subs
GROUP BY account_tier
ORDER BY account_tier;

SELECT outlet_id, outlet_name, city, state_code, seating_capacity
FROM restaurant_outlets
WHERE seating_capacity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY seating_capacity DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM guest_feedback ORDER BY visit_date DESC LIMIT 3;

WITH gm AS (
    SELECT
        tm.outlet_id,
        tm.full_name,
        tm.hire_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.outlet_id ORDER BY tm.hire_date) AS rn
    FROM team_members tm
    WHERE tm.role_title = 'General Manager'
)
SELECT
    ro.outlet_id,
    ro.outlet_name,
    gm.full_name AS general_manager_name,
    gm.hire_date AS general_manager_hire_date
FROM restaurant_outlets ro
LEFT JOIN gm ON ro.outlet_id = gm.outlet_id AND gm.rn = 1
ORDER BY ro.outlet_id;

SELECT
    gf.feedback_id,
    gf.outlet_id,
    ro.outlet_name,
    gf.visit_date,
    gf.guest_name,
    gf.rating,
    gf.comments,
    tm.full_name AS server_name
FROM guest_feedback gf
JOIN restaurant_outlets ro ON gf.outlet_id = ro.outlet_id
LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON gf.server_member_id = tm.member_id;

SELECT
    ro.outlet_id,
    ro.outlet_name,
    AVG(gf.rating) AS average_rating
FROM
    restaurant_outlets AS ro
JOIN
    guest_feedback AS gf ON ro.outlet_id = gf.outlet_id
GROUP BY
    ro.outlet_id, ro.outlet_name;

WITH outlet_avg AS (
    SELECT
        outlet_id,
        AVG(rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM guest_feedback
    GROUP BY outlet_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(rating) AS overall_rating FROM guest_feedback
)
SELECT
    ro.outlet_id,
    ro.outlet_name,
    oa.avg_rating
FROM outlet_avg oa
JOIN restaurant_outlets ro ON ro.outlet_id = oa.outlet_id
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE oa.avg_rating > o.overall_rating;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        outlet_id,
        MAX(date(REPLACE(last_restock_date, '/', '-'))) AS most_recent_restock
    FROM inventory_stock
    WHERE last_restock_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY outlet_id
)
SELECT
    ro.outlet_id,
    ro.outlet_name,
    n.most_recent_restock
FROM restaurant_outlets ro
LEFT JOIN normalized n ON ro.outlet_id = n.outlet_id
ORDER BY ro.outlet_id;
SELECT tier_name, monthly_fee FROM subscription_tiers ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM network_towers WHERE status = 'Active';
SELECT * FROM usage_events ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ue.event_id, ca.full_name AS customer_name, nt.tower_code, ue.event_timestamp, ue.session_type, ue.volume_mb, ue.duration_seconds, ue.technology
FROM usage_events ue
JOIN customer_accounts ca ON ue.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN network_towers nt ON ue.tower_id = nt.tower_id;

WITH region_tiers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sr.region_name, st.tier_name
    FROM service_regions sr
    JOIN customer_accounts ca ON sr.region_id = ca.region_id
    JOIN subscription_tiers st ON ca.tier_id = st.tier_id
)
SELECT region_name, tier_name
FROM region_tiers
ORDER BY region_name, tier_name;

SELECT sr.region_name, COUNT(ca.account_id) AS active_customers
FROM service_regions sr
LEFT JOIN customer_accounts ca ON sr.region_id = ca.region_id AND ca.account_status = 'Active'
GROUP BY sr.region_id, sr.region_name
ORDER BY sr.region_name;

WITH customer_data AS (
    SELECT
        ca.account_id,
        ca.account_number,
        ca.full_name,
        SUM(ue.volume_mb) AS total_data_mb
    FROM customer_accounts ca
    JOIN usage_events ue ON ca.account_id = ue.account_id
    WHERE ue.session_type = 'Data'
    GROUP BY ca.account_id, ca.account_number, ca.full_name
),
avg_data AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_data_mb) AS avg_total_data_mb FROM customer_data
)
SELECT
    cd.account_id,
    cd.account_number,
    cd.full_name,
    cd.total_data_mb
FROM customer_data cd, avg_data ad
WHERE cd.total_data_mb > ad.avg_total_data_mb
ORDER BY cd.total_data_mb DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ca.account_id, ca.account_number, ca.full_name, ca.email
FROM customer_accounts ca
JOIN subscription_tiers st ON ca.tier_id = st.tier_id
JOIN usage_events ue ON ca.account_id = ue.account_id
WHERE st.tier_name = 'Family Share'
  AND ue.session_type = 'Data'
  AND ue.technology IN ('5G NR', '5G NSA');
SELECT division_id, name, age_group, season_year, registration_fee FROM divisions ORDER BY registration_fee DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.name, d.name AS division
FROM teams t
JOIN divisions d ON t.division_id = d.division_id
WHERE t.practice_day = 'Tuesday';
SELECT * FROM players WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(birth_date, '/', '-')) = '2016' ORDER BY last_name;

SELECT c.name, c.city, COUNT(t.team_id) AS team_count
FROM clubs c
LEFT JOIN teams t ON c.club_id = t.club_id
GROUP BY c.club_id, c.name, c.city
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT ht.name AS home_team, at.name AS away_team, m.home_score || '-' || m.away_score AS final_score
FROM matches m
JOIN teams ht ON m.home_team_id = ht.team_id
JOIN teams at ON m.away_team_id = at.team_id
WHERE m.status = 'completed';

SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS full_name, t.name AS team_name, d.age_group
FROM players p
JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN divisions d ON t.division_id = d.division_id;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, COUNT(p.player_id) AS player_count
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN players p ON t.team_id = p.team_id
GROUP BY t.team_id, t.name
ORDER BY player_count DESC;

SELECT d.name AS division_name, COUNT(t.team_id) AS team_count
FROM divisions d
JOIN teams t ON d.division_id = t.division_id
GROUP BY d.division_id, d.name
HAVING COUNT(t.team_id) > 2;

WITH u10_division AS (
    SELECT division_id
    FROM divisions
    WHERE name = 'U10 Boys'
),
captains AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.jersey_number, p.team_id
    FROM players p
    JOIN u10_division d ON p.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE division_id = d.division_id)
    WHERE p.is_captain = 1
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS player_name,
       t.name AS team_name,
       c.jersey_number
FROM captains c
JOIN teams t ON c.team_id = t.team_id
ORDER BY t.name;
SELECT model_name, manufacturer, range_km FROM fleet_units ORDER BY range_km DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM crew_members WHERE date(REPLACE(hire_date, '/', '-')) > date('2020-01-01');
SELECT * FROM flight_legs WHERE leg_status = 'DELAYED';

SELECT
    fl.flight_number,
    h_origin.city AS origin_city,
    h_dest.city AS destination_city
FROM flight_legs fl
JOIN hubs h_origin ON fl.origin_hub_id = h_origin.hub_id
JOIN hubs h_dest ON fl.destination_hub_id = h_dest.hub_id;

SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN cm.role = 'PILOT' THEN cm.full_name END) AS pilot_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cm.role = 'CO_PILOT' THEN cm.full_name END) AS co_pilot_name
FROM crew_assignments ca
JOIN crew_members cm ON ca.crew_id = cm.crew_id
JOIN flight_legs fl ON ca.leg_id = fl.leg_id
WHERE fl.flight_number = 'VX-201'
  AND cm.role IN ('PILOT', 'CO_PILOT');

SELECT fl.flight_number, fu.model_name
FROM flight_legs fl
JOIN fleet_units fu ON fl.assigned_unit_id = fu.unit_id
WHERE fu.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fl.assigned_unit_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT h.hub_name, COUNT(c.crew_id) AS crew_count
FROM hubs h
LEFT JOIN crew_members c ON h.hub_id = c.base_hub_id
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
ORDER BY h.hub_name;

SELECT manufacturer, AVG(seating_capacity) AS avg_seating_capacity
FROM fleet_units
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY manufacturer;

SELECT fl.leg_id, fl.flight_number, fl.origin_hub_id, fl.destination_hub_id, fl.scheduled_departure, fl.scheduled_arrival, fl.assigned_unit_id, fl.leg_status
FROM flight_legs fl
JOIN fleet_units fu ON fl.assigned_unit_id = fu.unit_id
WHERE fu.range_km < 5000;

SELECT DISTINCT cm.full_name
FROM crew_members cm
JOIN crew_assignments ca ON cm.crew_id = ca.crew_id
JOIN flight_legs fl ON ca.leg_id = fl.leg_id
JOIN hubs origin_hub ON fl.origin_hub_id = origin_hub.hub_id
JOIN hubs base_hub ON cm.base_hub_id = base_hub.hub_id
WHERE cm.role = 'PILOT'
  AND origin_hub.city != base_hub.city;
